headlines.title: Trump Says Iran Talks to Resume After Strikes Called off
headlines.description: President Donald Trump announced the United States and Iran are set to resume talks following his decision to call off massive strikes over the weekend. There’s no confirmation from Iran but Iran’s foreign minister did say, “Negotiations are on the path to being finalized.” NBC’s Keir Simmons reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Israel says it has concerns with Hamas disarmament deal as it keeps up Gaza strikes
headlines.description: Israel says it has shared concerns with the United States about the proposed disarmament deal with Hamas, raising new doubts about the agreement touted by President Donald Trump.

headlines.title: Blanche Scraps ‘Anti-Weaponization’ Fund Ahead of Nomination
headlines.description: Acting Attorney General Todd Blanche’s nomination appears to be back on track after he announced a key decision to satisfy two Republican holdouts in the Senate who said they could not support his confirmation until the “anti-weaponization” fund was rescinded in writing. Now, Blanche posted an order establishing, “Beyond any doubt, there is no fund.” NBC’s Garrett Haake reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Ariana Grande to step back from public life following ‘scrutiny’
headlines.description: The singer and actor, who is on tour, will no longer star in the London revival of “Sunday in the Park With George,” which is set to open in summer 2027.

headlines.title: Spanish Soccer Star Ferran Torres Talks World Cup Win
headlines.description: Soccer star Ferran Torres joins TODAY to talk about Spain’s 2026 FIFA World Cup championship and shares insight into his epic extra-time goal in the final that sealed his team’s victory over Argentina. He also opens up about his mental health journey and gets surprised with gifts for his two dogs!

headlines.title: New video shows moment hero fires at shooter at Idaho In-and-Out
headlines.description: Police in Idaho are hailing an armed citizen a hero for distracting a gunman who opened fire outside an In-and-Out in Twin Falls, helping save lives. Officials say three people were killed and seven others were injured in the shooting. NBC News’ Dana Griffin reports from the scene.

headlines.title: Massive Washington Wildfires Force Thousands to Evacuate
headlines.description: Flames are tearing through Spokane in Washington state, forcing more than 60,000 to evacuate. Neighborhoods are obliterated with shells of homes left behind. NBC’s Morgan Chesky reports for TODAY.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: Phil Collins says he nearly died in 2024 after years of alcohol abuse
headlines.description: Years of alcohol abuse brought rock icon Phil Collins to death’s door two years ago with loved ones rushing to his bedside “to say goodbye,” the legendary singer and drummer said in an interview published over the weekend.

headlines.title: Mauricio Pochettino to return as U.S. Soccer coach for 2030 World Cup
headlines.description: Mauricio Pochettino agreed to remain U.S.

headlines.title: Iran denies Trump claim that new talks will start Monday after he called off attacks
headlines.description: The United States and Iran will hold new talks Monday afternoon, President Donald Trump said, after announcing he called off intense new strikes to allow for a deal on the Strait of Hormuz and Tehran’s nuclear program.
